integrity: A self-contained proof is provided and the standalone standard-library verifier has been executed; numerical checks are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The O(log n) term is not resolved to an exact coefficient or oscillatory profile.
Only odd indices are covered; even indices inherit values by binary scaling.
Unindexed or more general prior asymptotic results are not excluded.
title: Two-term logarithmic growth of the semi-Pell sequence at odd indices
